sources.title: Camosun College Statement of Financial Information 2023/24: employee remuneration and expenses
notes: Complete published named employee schedule; source blanks and dashes are null. Separate board, supplier and aggregate scopes excluded. Annual remuneration as published, not base annual salary.

The original expressly excludes employees who are board members and severance amounts from this employee schedule; it is incomplete for all employees. Board-related employee amounts remain in the separate source board scope.

Published named controls differ from the sums of the displayed rows: remuneration sum 64,382,424.00 versus printed 64,382,428.00 (residual -4.00); disclosed expenses sum 1,444,799.00 versus printed 1,445,305.00 (residual -506.00). Rows are reproduced as published; the cause is not established.

The same-label compiled partition is retained separately because this official schedule excludes board-member employees and severance. Compiled periods and scope remain unverified; the two partitions may overlap and must not be summed as unique employees.
